mapper.select: SELECT s.id, r.id AS registrationId, r.competition_id AS competitionId, s.anonymous_code AS anonymousCode, s.locked_version_id AS lockedVersionId, s.locked_at AS lockedAt, s.eligibility_status AS eligibilityStatus, s.eligibility_reason AS eligibilityReason, s.row_version AS rowVersion, r.registration_no AS registrationNo, r.team_display_name AS teamDisplayName, (SELECT v.title FROM submission_version v WHERE v.submission_id = s.id ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestTitle, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_assignment a WHERE a.submission_version_id = s.locked_version_id AND a.status = 'SUBMITTED') AS scored FROM registration r LEFT JOIN submission s ON s.registration_id = r.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
